source_note: Universe: HKEX List of Securities. Chinese short names: Sina HK quote API. Market cap: Tencent HK quote API, in HKD 100m. Price/K-line: Yahoo Finance chart API. US/global reference data is handled through Yahoo/official public links when needed.
